title: Toggl Billable vs Non-Billable Split
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=toggl:timeentry
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(eval(if(billable="true",duration_min,0))) as billable_min, sum(duration_min) as total_min by client _time
| eval billable_pct=round(100*billable_min/total_min,1)
| where total_min>0
| sort - billable_pct
description: Uses Toggl billing metadata telemetry to monitor how work time splits between billable and non-billable buckets in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for clients or months where effort is not translating into billed time, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Toggl billing metadata data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It blends how work time splits between billable and non-billable buckets so you can spot clients or months where effort is not translating into billed time before it becomes annoying.
